dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp white margins create distinct linear boundaries against the darker feather centers of the folded wings.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; a gradual transition occurs as the small speckles on the crown increase in size toward the mantle without a linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive pattern of dark, sub-terminal markings on a white base, creating a high-contrast tessellated effect across the entire dorsal view.
